standard_prerequisites.name: Homotopy equivalences of complexes and their compatibility with an inverse system
standard_prerequisites.use: Is the invariance that allows the representative system to be replaced stage by stage.

standard_prerequisites.name: Factoring a map of complexes as a homotopy equivalence followed by a termwise split surjection
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies both the homotopy equivalence and the surjectivity at each inductive step.

core_obligations: Let K be represented by the system (K_n^bullet) and set M_1^bullet = K_1^bullet (proof lines 23789-23790).

Assume constructed surjective maps M_n^bullet -> ... -> M_1^bullet and homotopy equivalences psi_e : K_e^bullet -> M_e^bullet such that the displayed squares commute for all e < n (proof lines 23790-23799).
Consider the displayed diagram involving K_{n+1}^bullet -> K_n^bullet and K_n^bullet -> M_n^bullet (proof lines 23800-23806).

Use the make-a-map-surjective lemma to factor the composite K_{n+1}^bullet -> M_n^bullet as K_{n+1}^bullet -> M_{n+1}^bullet -> M_n^bullet where the first arrow is a homotopy equivalence and the second is a termwise split surjection (proof lines 23807-23811).
Conclude by induction that K is represented by the system (M_n^bullet) with all transition maps surjective (proof lines 23811-23812).
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that for an inverse system of rings (A_n), every object K of the derived category of the module-valued inverse systems can be represented by a system of complexes (M_n^bullet) all of whose transition maps M_{n+1}^bullet -> M_n^bullet are surjective (source lines 23779-23786). The proof is an induction replacing the transition maps one at a time. If K is represented by the system (K_n^bullet), the proof sets M_1^bullet = K_1^bullet and assumes surjective maps M_n^bullet -> ... -> M_1^bullet together with homotopy equivalences psi_e : K_e^bullet -> M_e^bullet making the displayed squares commute for all e < n (proof lines 23789-23799). The inductive step is the substantive part: considering the displayed diagram K_{n+1}^bullet -> K_n^bullet and K_n^bullet -> M_n^bullet, the proof invokes the make-a-map-surjective lemma to factor the composite K_{n+1}^bullet -> M_n^bullet as K_{n+1}^bullet -> M_{n+1}^bullet -> M_n^bullet with the first arrow a homotopy equivalence and the second a termwise split surjection (proof lines 23800-23811). The lemma then follows by induction (proof lines 23811-23812). The non-routine content is the choice of the factoring lemma, which supplies simultaneously the homotopy equivalence needed for compatibility and the surjectivity needed for the conclusion.
